regular_rules.rule: p + ol introduces fresh Paint material M1; this is a productive nominal introduction, not a pigment name.
Ingredient root introduces an Ingredient entity; unconsumed standalone Ingredients enter explicit queue. No ambient additives.
o + Ingredient disperses that written Ingredient; q + Ingredient measures it and queues it. These are Ingredient-to-Ingredient operations.
ol + Ingredient selects active Paint and incorporates the written new Ingredient, returning the same Paint identity. It does not consume the independent queue.
ol + Property selects active Paint and assigns that physical property; bare ol selects active Paint.

q + Paint expression creates fresh portion with source-parent equal to the evaluated Paint and makes it active. s + Paint expression creates a retained working portion with the same parent rule; neither is exhaustive division. Repeated q applications each create a new portion.
Paint-processing predicates require active Paint, consume the whole explicit Ingredient queue, and preserve Paint identity; no event-to-material conversion.

Application predicates require active Paint and a previously written Surface/Region; create fresh Layer attached to that recipient, preserve remaining Paint and preserve earlier Layers. They do not invent a recipient.
Layer predicates/properties require the latest explicitly created Layer and preserve its recipient. No Paint-to-Layer cast.
dol introduces Region only from a written Surface. shol explicitly introduces Surface and does not pretend to decompose as sh+ol.
shey+r iterates the same typed mixing event. ol+shey explicitly selects Paint patient before mixing, whether fused or spaced.
Unknown group is an execution barrier; subsequent conditional contributions are not carried through it as a complete reading.

whole_form_residuals.ockhy: W1: finely grind active Paint, preserving its identity
whole_form_residuals.chedy: W2: separate fresh working Paint portion, make it active, preserve source parent

defaults.rule: Paint predicates lacking explicit ol take the uniquely maintained active Paint.
Application uses latest explicitly introduced recipient; no cross-paragraph owner.
Layer predicates use latest explicitly created Layer.
Dry uses latest actual Paint-or-Layer event result. Ingredient creation and recipient introduction do not change this register.

preconditions: Two application predicates are consumed in a common admitted scope without an unknown barrier and without a new recipient replacing R.
consequence: Apply1(P1,R) -> fresh Layer L1, owner(L1)=R; remaining Paint P1 persists.
Apply2(P2,R) -> fresh Layer L2 distinct from L1, owner(L2)=R; L1 persists.
QOKEEY after Apply2 acts on L2 and preserves R. TCHCTHY and LOM after that act on L2, not Paint or L1.
DOL(R) -> fresh Region B, owner(B)=R, making B the next recipient.
If another SHOL intervenes, it introduces R2 and a following application uses R2 under D2; R2 is not silently aliased to R.
If a Paint-processing event intervenes before KEEDY, D4 selects that latest Paint result; KEEDY is not always a Layer-drying word.
nonconsequences: No counted three stages or exactly three Layers.
No Layer-on-Layer placement or above/below relation; common Surface allows disjoint painted areas.
No visible first Layer; physical persistence does not prove optical visibility.
No saved named recipe return; FO contains no recipe-type reference store.
No inherited white/dark/fine property on every new portion.
No cross-paragraph owner borrowing under D2.

serial_layers.content: Successive applications form retained coats of one product on one owner.
necessary_written_duties: A shared written Surface identity for all alleged coats.
Distinct application events with Paint and Surface/Region arguments and distinct deposited Layer results.
An explicit bridge between separately illustrated row owners and those Layer results.
For physical stacked layers rather than repeated/disjoint coatings: explicit common location or overlap and relative depth/earlier-layer visibility.
serial_layers.frozen_FO_capacity: Conditional creation and retention of two Layers can be stated; three-row identification, cross-record shared owner, stack order and visibility are not supplied.
serial_layers.image_requirement: Independent owner annotation must distinguish painted support/result layers from container and detached plant-fragment records; three horizontal rows alone fail this duty.

parallel_material_register.content: Separate rows catalogue materials or preparations, with local labels attached to containers and plant fragments; no serial deposited-layer identity is required.
necessary_written_duties: Independent row/record boundaries and local label-to-container/fragment bindings.
Separate local Material introductions or an explicit common precursor feeding distinct results if a branching version is claimed.
No result-to-input identity inferred from repeated form or vessel similarity.
parallel_material_register.frozen_FO_capacity: Paint/Ingredient/portion roles may provide only a conditional local material account. Container/PlantFragment label roles need new meanings and independent ownership bridges; they cannot be inferred by relabeling FO Surface or Layer.
parallel_material_register.comparison: Coarse row ownership consistent with a register is not a semantic winner; a serial chain also remains unscorable without precise written source/result owners.

homogeneous_mixture.content: Written Ingredients combine into a single Paint material, while source ingredients are consumed rather than retained as separate Layers.
necessary_written_duties: Explicit G2/G3 Ingredient introductions and G7 queued consumption into active Paint.
No automatic Layer result from mixing.
homogeneous_mixture.contrast: Separately addressable deposited Layers require G8 application, so mixture and Layer graphs differ in patient/result types; mere green pigment does not select either.

classification_contract.LOCAL_UNKNOWN: Unrecognized written form or unpaid role: preserve it; no free entity; unknown group execution barrier. This is incomplete coverage, not disproof of an already typed role.
classification_contract.MISSING_WRITTEN_ARGUMENT: A proposed application lacks a paid Paint or Surface/Region input. No valid application derivation; this is a composition debt. It becomes an actual counterexample only to a predeclared claim requiring full local derivation there.
classification_contract.UNSCOREABLE_OWNERSHIP: No unique independent text-label/picture owner or no common-owner identity across rows. Do not score as match, type failure or independent confirmation.
classification_contract.ACTUAL_TYPED_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Only after explicit written identity and independently fixed owner make a required type impossible: for example an application recipient is proved to be a Material identity with no Surface/Region constructor; or QOKEEY is forced to Paint with no Layer producer. Physical objects can have surfaces, but FO has no automatic Material/Container/Fragment-to-Surface coercion.
classification_contract.CONDITIONAL_COMPATIBILITY: A correctly bound application/Layer graph is compatible with FO; author-invented role labels do not empirically select painting.

A specified segmentation and record/paragraph scope consistent with raw boundaries; one cannot join three prose blocks into one execution scope because rows are horizontal.
